summary: Iteration 4 tests all PASSED. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests green (renov_goal/raised/note in GET /api/settings, PUT persistence, GET+PUT /api/pages/{key} for 14 arbitrary keys, unauth 401 on PUT, donations packages no-regression). Frontend: /renovare shows renov-progress with renov-raised=42.000 RON and renov-percent=28% derived from settings; progress-donate-btn present; gallery thumbs render (2 seeded images); language switcher (lang-de/lang-en) is gone from both homepage and internal /renovare. Admin flow verified: login → Pagini tab lists all 15 configured pages (home, history, about, community, resources, renovation, contact, donate, newsletter, calendar, patron, priest, catechesis, prayers, announcements, magazine); editing Renovare title/intro and saving reflects on /renovare after full reload (marker matched). Settings tab renovation-fund fields (set-renov-goal/set-renov-raised) exist; updating to 200000/50000 correctly changes /renovare to 50.000 / 25%. Content editors are RO-only (3 RO placeholders, 0 DE, 0 EN) — announcements creation still works. All test data restored (renov defaults 150000/42000; renovation page override cleared).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/pages/{page_key} accepts arbitrary keys with no whitelist — acceptable given auth gate, but consider validating page_key against a known set to prevent unbounded collection growth from typos.

MultiLang schema still holds ro/de/en fields backend-side even though the frontend now writes ro-only; harmless but wastes storage. Could shrink to a plain str once site is confirmed RO-only long term.
server.py is 762 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, content, pages, settings, donations, newsletter) for maintainability.
Renovation.jsx RenovationProgress computes pct = round(raised/goal*100); acceptable but for pct display with fractional values consider Math.floor to avoid showing 100% before actually reaching goal.

SiteContentContext caches /api/pages at app mount only — full reload is required after edits. Consider a light refetch on route change or invalidate-on-save for smoother admin UX (not a bug, UX enhancement).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral markers for renovation page (cleaned up); settings temporarily set to 200000/50000 then restored to 150000/42000.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Existing tests: backend_test.py (base), test_donations.py (Stripe), test_new_features.py (newsletter/pages/dyn-donations), test_iteration4.py (renov settings + pages for all page keys). SiteContentContext caches /api/pages at mount — always full-navigate after PUT /api/pages/*. Non-blocking 401s in browser console come from /api/auth/me pre-login and are expected.
